data.value: Use LoadingMessage for status content and LoadingMessageTemplate to customize how it is rendered.

data.name: Page_MessageBox_Section_Icon_Description

data.value: Turn the title on or off independently of the message body.

data.value: Select the available response buttons and inspect the returned MessageBoxResult.

data.name: Page_MessageBox_Section_Presentation_Modes_Description
data.value: Use a desktop MessageBox window where supported, or switch to OverlayMessageBox for an in-app dialog on browser and mobile.

data.name: Page_MessageBox_Section_Style_Class_Description
data.value: Pass the Compact class to apply the demo's app-level style, which reduces message box padding.

data.name: Page_MessageBox_Section_Observable_Content_Description
data.value: Provide IObservable<string> sources to update the message and title while the message box remains open.

data.name: Page_Notification_Section_Manager_Wiring_Description
data.value: Create or reuse a WindowNotificationManager for the current TopLevel before calling Show.

data.name: Page_Notification_Section_Position_Description
data.value: Set Position to choose among the six notification placements.

data.name: Page_Notification_Section_Icon_Description
data.value: Use showIcon to show or hide the notification type icon.

data.name: Page_Notification_Section_Show_Close_Description
data.value: Use showClose to let users dismiss a notification manually.

data.name: Page_Notification_Section_Light_Style_Description
data.value: Pass the Light class to use light backgrounds and type-specific borders.

data.name: Page_Notification_Section_Close_Reason_Description
data.value: Use onClose to receive Timeout, UserAction, or Displaced when a notification closes.

data.name: Page_Toast_Section_Manager_Setup_Description
data.value: Create a WindowToastManager for the current TopLevel, set the maximum number of visible toasts, and uninstall it when the view detaches.

data.name: Page_Toast_Section_Types_Description
data.value: Choose Information, Success, Warning, or Error to match the message.

data.name: Page_Toast_Section_Icon_Description
data.value: Use showIcon to display or hide the icon associated with the toast type.

data.name: Page_Toast_Section_Close_Button_Description
data.value: Use showClose to let users dismiss a toast before it expires.

data.name: Page_Toast_Section_Expiration_Description
data.value: Set expiration to control how long the toast stays visible. TimeSpan.Zero keeps it open until it is dismissed.

data.name: Page_Toast_Section_Light_Style_Description
data.value: Pass the Light class for a light background and a border colored to match the toast type.

data.name: Page_Toast_Section_Click_Callback_Description
data.value: Use onClick to run an action when the user clicks the toast.

data.name: Page_Toast_Section_Close_Reason_Description
data.value: Use onClose to observe why a toast closed, such as timeout, user action, or displacement.

data.name: Page_PopConfirm_Section_Basic_Description

data.name: Page_PopConfirm_Section_Trigger_Modes_Description
data.value: Click is the default. Combine Focus and Click to also open the popup when keyboard navigation focuses the trigger.

data.name: Page_PopConfirm_Section_Non_Button_Trigger_Description
data.value: A Button opens the popup on Click; other child controls open it on PointerPressed.

data.name: Page_PopConfirm_Section_Placement_Description
data.value: Set Placement to choose where the popup appears relative to its trigger.

data.name: Page_PopConfirm_Section_Async_Command_Description
data.value: With HandleAsyncCommand enabled, the popup stays open while an async command runs and closes when it completes.

data.name: Page_PopConfirm_Section_Icon_Styles_Description
data.value: Use Information, Success, Warning, or Error to change the built-in icon and its color.

data.name: Page_PopConfirm_Section_Custom_Icon_Description
data.value: Set the Icon property to replace the built-in icon with custom content.

data.name: Page_ThemeToggler_Section_Global_Description
data.value: By default, ThemeToggleButton controls the application-wide theme and switches between Light and Dark. If the application must set RequestedThemeVariant to ThemeVariant.Default, set IsThreeState to true so the toggle can select Default.

data.name: Page_ThemeToggler_Section_Three_State_Description
data.value: Set IsThreeState to true to cycle through Light, Dark, and Default (system) themes.

data.name: Page_ThemeToggler_Section_Indicator_Description
data.value: Indicator mode displays the current Light, Dark, or Default theme without applying a theme change.

data.name: Page_ThemeToggler_Section_Scoped_Theme_Description
data.value: Place content in ThemeVariantScope and set TargetScope to change only that scope. A toggle inside a scope can target it automatically.

data.name: Page_PathPicker_Section_Open_File_Description
data.value: Use UsePickerType=OpenFile to open a file picker. FileFilter limits the file types users can choose.

data.name: Page_PathPicker_Section_Save_File_Description
data.value: Use SaveFile with SuggestedFileName, DefaultFileExtension, and FileFilter to configure the save dialog.

data.name: Page_PathPicker_Section_Folder_Selection_Description
data.value: Use OpenFolder to select a directory. Set AllowMultiple to true when users may choose more than one folder.

data.name: Page_PathPicker_Section_Multiple_Selection_Description
data.value: Set AllowMultiple and bind SelectedPaths to collect the paths selected by the user.

data.name: Page_PathPicker_Section_Command_Cancel_Description
data.value: Command receives the selected IReadOnlyList<IStorageItem>. IsOmitCommandOnCancel controls command execution on cancel, while IsClearSelectionOnCancel controls whether the current selection is cleared.

data.name: Page_PathPicker_Section_Appearance_Description
data.value: The Top class docks the browse button above the text field. ButtonPathPicker shows only a button, ListPathPicker displays selected paths in an expandable list, and ButtonContent replaces the default browse button content.

data.name: Page_PathPicker_Section_Command_Description
data.value: PathPicker.Command receives an IReadOnlyList<IStorageItem>. Cast items to IStorageFile to call OpenReadAsync for a stream, or to IStorageFolder for folder-specific access. TryGetLocalPath may return null when a provider does not expose a local path.

data.name: Page_WindowDialog_Section_Position_Description
data.value: Choose the startup location. Supply both X and Y to set an explicit pixel position.

data.name: Page_WindowDialog_Section_Buttons_Description
data.value: Choose a dialog mode and the buttons shown in the standard dialog footer.

data.name: Page_WindowDialog_Section_Close_Button_Description
data.value: Use the three-state option to show, hide, or inherit the window close button visibility.

data.name: Page_WindowDialog_Section_Window_Options_Description
data.value: Control taskbar visibility, dragging, and resizing for the window.

data.name: Page_WindowDialog_Section_Style_Class_Description
data.value: Enter `Custom` to apply the application's StandardDialogWindow.Custom style: the OK button becomes a warning button labeled CUSTOM. Clear the class for the default style.

data.name: Page_WindowDialog_Section_Variants_Description
data.value: Standard dialogs provide built-in buttons; custom dialogs use your own view. Toggle Modal to switch the custom dialog between modal and modeless APIs.

data.name: Page_OverlayDialog_Section_Position_Description
data.value: Set horizontal and vertical anchors and optional offsets to position the overlay.

data.name: Page_OverlayDialog_Section_Buttons_Description
data.value: Choose the mode and footer buttons for a standard overlay dialog.

data.value: Enable light dismiss to close on outside clicks; use the three-state close button option to show, hide, or inherit its visibility.

data.name: Page_OverlayDialog_Section_Layout_Description
data.value: Toggle full screen, dragging, and resizing of the overlay dialog.

data.name: Page_OverlayDialog_Section_Host_Description
data.value: Use the global host for an app-wide overlay, or select Local to show the dialog inside the bordered OverlayDialogHost below.

data.value: Enter `Custom` to apply the host window's StandardDialogControl.Custom style: the OK button becomes a warning button labeled CUSTOM. Clear the class for the default style.

data.value: Standard overlays have built-in buttons; custom overlays use your own view. Toggle Modal to choose whether the custom dialog blocks interaction.

data.name: Page_WindowDialog_Section_Basic_Usage_Description
data.value: Open a standard window dialog with its default buttons and behavior using a single call.

data.name: Page_WindowDialog_Section_Positioning_Description
data.value: Choose a startup location, or set both X and Y to place the dialog at a specific screen coordinate.

data.name: Page_WindowDialog_Section_Custom_Content_Description
data.value: Use the custom dialog API to show your own view and view model instead of the built-in standard dialog content.

data.name: Page_WindowDialog_Section_Modality_Description
data.value: Use the async custom-dialog API for a modal window, or the non-async API to open a modeless window.

data.name: Page_OverlayDialog_Section_Basic_Usage_Description
data.value: Open a standard overlay dialog in the global overlay host with a single call.

data.name: Page_OverlayDialog_Section_Positioning_Description
data.value: Choose horizontal and vertical anchors and adjust the position with optional offsets.

data.name: Page_OverlayDialog_Section_Light_Dismiss_Description
data.value: Enable light dismiss to close the dialog when the user clicks outside it.

data.name: Page_OverlayDialog_Section_Local_Host_Description
data.value: Choose the global host for an app-wide dialog or a local OverlayDialogHost to constrain it to a specific part of the view.

data.name: Page_OverlayDialog_Section_Modality_Description
data.value: Use the async API to await a modal overlay dialog, or the non-async API to show a modeless overlay.

data.name: Page_OverlayDialog_Section_Custom_Content_Description
data.value: Use the custom overlay API to render your own view and view model inside the overlay.
